normal_callability.target_scope: GENCODE/Ensembl 103 primary nuclear CDS and start/stop codons, with 100-bp flanks
normal_callability.source: Native GATK GVCF genotype evidence, clipped to requested intervals

normal_self_search_scope.unphased_combinations: Potential self; conservatively exclude hits, do not claim measured phase
normal_self_search_scope.negative_result: No hit in the searched genotyped coding models; not proof of normal-tissue absence

alignment.next: Identity/contamination, coverage and paired variant calling; assess BQSR separately

normal_metadata.strategy: Native BaseRecalibrator --default-platform UNKNOWN; no separate header-copy BAM

bqsr.application: Native ApplyBQSR on disjoint whole-contig groups plus no-coordinate tail; native GatherBamFiles

audit.scope: 17 current substitutions only; not nomination for full paired discovery
audit.normal_callability_rule: At least 20 unambiguous qualifying fragment names and complete compatible native normal genotype GQ>=20; reference support also requires fewer than three normal ALT names

normal-coding/gather.scope: GENCODE/Ensembl 103 primary nuclear CDS and start/stop codons, with 100-bp flanks

paired/filter.scope: All newly emitted paired calls; no old variant whitelist

construct/mrna.source_adaptation: Same pinned encoder and GenBank verifier; new protein, selection hashes and design labels
